33† And againe she conceaued and bare a ſonne, and ſaid : For
becauſe our Lord heard that I was contemned, he hath
geuen this alſo to me : and she called his name Simeon.
34† And she conceaued the third time, and bare an other
ſonne: and ſaid : Now alſo my huſband wil be ioyned to me,
for becauſe I haue borne him three ſonnes : and therfore
she called his name, Leui. † The fourth time she conceaued
and bare a ſonne, and ſaid : Now wil I conffeſſe to our Lord.
And for this she called him Iuda : And she left bearing.
